title: Pregnant Blend 2-Mix Solo #01 (대각 띠 4구역·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Egyptian woman, an adult, in her early 30s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, soft pastel-pink hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing a single piece of silver a hair ornament. Full body painted in 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 4 regions of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 30% of the way down her figure from the top, about 50% of the way down her figure from the top and about 68% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, with medallion scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 2. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
